s: Seder harauy litqiat shopar ubo k"a seipim: kamma teqiot chayyab adam lishmoa berosh hashshana? Tesha — tr"t tr"t tr"t, lepi sheshshalosh peamim terua neemar battora, shenayim berosh hashshana veechad beyom hakkippurim shel yobel, umippi hashshemua lamedu shehen lemedin zeh mizzeh, ulekak hare hu keillu kol hashshalosh peamim terua neemarim bekol achat mehen, vekol terua tzerika lihyot peshuta lepaneha upeshuta leachareha, vehen hanniqraim teqiot setam, shenneemar "vehaabarta shopar terua", mashma shetztzarik lehaabir qol pashut veachar kak tihyeh hatterua, dilshon "vehaabarta" mashma haabarat qol pashut, veachar hatterua neemar "taabiru shopar vego'", mashma sheachar hatterua tzarik gam ken lehaabir qol pashut, veken bekol terua uterua ben shel yobel ben shel rosh hashshana shehen lemedin zeh mizzeh:

Terua zo haamura battora metargeminan "yebaba", uketib "bead hachallon nishqepa vatteyabbeb em sisera", mashma shehaybaba hi keqol sheadam mashmia keshehu bokeh umeyallel, veyesh lehistappeq im yebaba zo hi kemo shedderek hacholim shemmaarikim bignichotam umashmiim qol achar qol umaarikim bahem qetzat, vezeh niqra ganach, o shehi kemo adam hamyallel umeqonen shemmashmia qolot qetzarim meod tekupim zeh lazeh, vezeh niqra yallel, o shehi kemo shenehem beyachad zeh achar zeh haylala achar haggenicha, shekken derek habbokeh meganneach veachar kak meyallel. Vetiqqenu chakamim kede latzet yede kol hassepeqot litqoa tshr"t g' peamim, shemma hatterua hi genicha vilala beyachad, veachar kak tsh"t g' peamim, shemma hatterua hi genicha lebad, vehayu haylalot hepseq ben hatterua lehatteqia shelleachareha, vehattora omra peshuta leachareha belo hepseq qol shopar sheeno pashut benetayim, veachar kak tr"t g' peamim, shemma hatterua hi haylala lebad, vehayu haggenicha shebbeseder tshr"t hepseq ben hatterua latteqia shellepaneha:

Im hitna bitqia acharona shel g' sidre tshr"t sheim seder tshr"t hen hen iqqar hammitzva taaleh lo teqia zo litqia acharona shel tshr"t veim sidre tsh"t hen iqqar hammitzva ubahen hu yotze yede choba taaleh lo teqia zo litqia rishona shel tsh"t — eno tzarik litqoa shenit lipne tsh"t harishon, shehare mimmah napshak hu yotze bitqia zo. Veken haddin im hitna bitqia acharona shel tsh"t shettaaleh lo litqia rishona shel tr"t. Abal im lo hitna ken — en teqia achat ola lishne sedarim tshr"t vetash"t velo letash"t vetar"t, lepi shemmitzvot tzerikot kavvana. Veim nitkavven bitqia zo lehashlamat seder tshr"t — enah ola lehatchalat tsh"t, sheim tsh"t iqqar hammitzva im ken keshennitkavven bitqia zo lehashlamat tshr"t lo taqa leshem mitzva kelal. Veken bitqia shebben tsh"t letar"t:

Shiur teqia haamura battora keshiur terua haamura battora, veshiur terua haamura battora keg' yebabot. Yesh omerim dehaynu g' kochot bealma, vehem niqraim terumitin, veakshav shettiqqenu chakamim litqoa tshr"t tsh"t tr"t kede latzet mikkol hassepeqot sheyyesh batterua — tzarik lehaarik bitqia shel tshr"t keshiur terua shel seder tshr"t, dehaynu g' shebarim benonim shehem keg' genichot benoniyyot ukeg' yelalot qetannot, shehare hakkol beyachad hu terua shel seder tshr"t, ubeseder tsh"t eno tzarik lehaarik bitqiotayv ella kede shiur g' shebarim benonim, shezzehu shiur terua shel seder tsh"t, ubitqiot shel seder tr"t eno tzarik lehaarik ella kede shiur g' yelalot qetannot, shezzehu shiur terua shel seder tr"t. Veim rotzeh lehaarik harbeh bekol teqia — hareshut beyado lehaarik kamma sheyyirtzeh, velo ameru shiur latteqiot ella shello yipchot mehashshiur. Veken batterua yakol lehaarik bitrumitin kamma sheyyirtzeh. Veken bashshebarim im mosip al g' shebarim — en bekak kelum, veeno kemapsiq ben hatterua o hashshebarim latteqia shelleacharayv, kevan sheoseh kol hashshebarim o kol hatterumitin binshima achat. Umikkol maqom nahagu shello lehosip al g' shebarim, abal terumitin yakol laasot kamma sheyyirtzeh. Veyesh osin besop hag' shebarim qol pashut keen teqia, veken osin besop hatterumitin. Abal en hamminhag laasot ken:

Vetzarik lizzaher bashshebarim shel seder tshr"t shello yaarik besheber echad mehag' shebarim kede shiur g' shebarim benonim veg' yelalot dehaynu terumitin, shezzehu shiur teqia shel seder tshr"t, veim maarik besheber echad keshiur zeh — yetze mikkelal sheber veyiqqare beshem teqia. Ubeseder tsh"t sheshshiur teqia hu keg' shebarim benonim — lo yaarik besheber echad kede shiur g' shebarim benonim, shello yetze mikkelal sheber veyiqqare beshem teqia. Veim lo nizhar bekak — apillu bediabad lo yatza (lepi sebara zo). Ulekattechilla tob lizzaher sheapillu beseder tshr"t lo yaarik besheber echad kede shiur [g'] terumitin, lepi shezzehu shiur teqia shel seder tr"t, veim yaarik kashshiur hazzeh yehe alayv shem teqiat tr"t lo shem sheber, ulepikak tob leqatztzer bekol sheber vasheber bekol mah deepshar, raq shello yeqatztzer yoter midday kede sheyyehe alayv shem genicha velo shem yelala dehaynu terumitin:

Veyesh omerim sheshshiur yebaba hi g' terumitin, veshiur terua keg' yebabot shehem t' terumitin, veshiur teqia keshiur terua gam ken t' terumitin, veshiur shebarim bevadday lo pachot hu mishshiur terua gam ken t' terumitin lekol happachot, veim ken tzarik lehaarik bekol sheber lo pachot mig' terumitin kede shebbeg' shebarim beyachad lo yehe pachot mit' terumitin keshiur terua. Ulepi dibrehem tzarik lehaarik bitqiot shel tshr"t lo pachot min y"ch terumitin, shezzehu shiur terua shel seder tshr"t, dehaynu g' genichot veg' yebabot beyachad shehem lo pachot mi"ch terumitin. Veyakol lehaarik bekol sheber ad pachot meat min y"ch terumitin, lepi shead y"ch terumitin en shem teqia. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla lo yaarik besheber echad kede t' terumitin, shezzeh shiur teqia beseder tr"t, veim ken shem teqiat tr"t alayv. Abal bediabad yotze im heerik besheber shel tshr"t pachot mi"ch terumitin, kevan shebbezeh hasseder adayin en alayv shem teqia. Ubeseder shel tsh"t tzarik lehaarik batteqiot keshiur t' terumitin, shezzehu shiur [terua] shel zeh hasseder. Velo yaarik besheber keshiur t' terumitin, veim heerik — apillu bediabad lo yatza, lepi sheyyatza mikkelal sheber veniknas biklal teqiot shel zeh hasseder:

Uleinyan halaka, yesh lehachamir beshel tora kisbara haacharona, dehaynu sheyyaarik bitqiot tshr"t keshiur y"ch terumitin lekol happachot, ubitqiot tsh"t tr"t keshiur t' terumitin lekol happachot, ubekol sheber yaarik meat kede g' terumitin, velo yaarik ad t' terumitin apillu beseder tshr"t, ubekol terua tzarik laasot t' terumitin kemo shennitbaer. Abal bediabad shekkebar taqa veshinna echad mikkol ellu — eno tzarik lachazor velitqoa, mippene sheyyesh lismok al sebara harishona. Abal im shinna bishne debarim beinyan shellepi shette hassebarot lo yatza, kegon shello heerik bitqiotayv keshiur shennitbaer lepi sebara haacharona veheerik besheber min hashshebarim yoter mishshiur shennitbaer lepi sebara harishona, o shello heerik besheber echad min hashshebarim keshiur shennitbaer lepi sebara haacharona dehaynu g' terumitin ubesheber echad min hashshebarim heerik yoter mishshiur shennitbaer lepi sebara harishona — tzarik lachazor velitqoa (kedin hattoeh bitqiotayv veal derek sheyyitbaer), veeno yakol litpos qullot shel shette hassebarot kevan shehen soterot zo et zo:

Haybabot shel teruot veken hag' shebarim shehem bimqom terua — tzarik laasotan binshima achat. Veim lo asaan binshima achat — lo yatza, shetterua achat omra tora velo mupseqet lishte teruot. Abal hashshelosha shebarim uterua detashar"t ap al pi sheshtehen beyachad hen bimqom terua achat haamura battora, deshemma hi haggenicha vehaylala beyachad zo achar zo, ap al pi ken en tzarik laasotan binshima achat, lepi sheen derek haadam lignoach uleyallel binshima achat ella mapsiq benehem kede neshima, dehaynu sheoseh neshima benetayim, ulepikak gam hattoqea tzarik laasot neshima benetayim. Umikkol maqom lo yapsiq yoter mikkede laasot neshima achat benetayim. Velo yamtin milleharia ad sheyyiqra hammaqri lepanayv millat terua, ella yaria meatzmo achar hashshebarim tekep umiyyad leachar sheasa neshima achat:

Veyesh omerim deap al pi sheen derek haadam lignoach uleyallel binshima achat, mikkol maqom kevan demah sheanu toqein shebarim uterua hu mechamat sapeq deshemma zehu terua haamura battora, im ken en lanu lehapsiq, shehare terua achat omra tora velo mupseqet lishte teruot. Lepikak im asaan bishte neshimot — lo yatza, ella yaaseh otan binshima achat. Umikkol maqom yapsiq meat benehem beinyan sheyyihyu nechlaqin lishte qolot. Vehamminhag bimdinot ellu kassebara harishona, veen leshannot hamminhag mippene hammachaloqet. Abal bemaqom sheen minhag qabua yesh lehanhig laasot bitqiot meyushshab binshima achat, kede shettihyeh habberaka shemmebarekin alehem kahalaka ledibre hakkol, sheap lassebara harishona yesh omerim sheim asaan binshima achat yatza, kemo hattoqea tr"t o tsh"t binshima achat deyatza kemo sheyyitbaer. Abal bitqiot meummad sheen mebarekin alehem — yaaseh bishte neshimot, kede lachosh lisbarat mi sheomer delassebara harishona im asaan binshima achat lo yatza. Hattoqea tr"t o tsh"t binshima achat, im hipsiq meat benehem beinyan sheyyihyu nechelaqin leg' qolot — yatza. Veyesh omerim shello yatza, vetzarik lachazor velitqoa kol hag' qolot, shehatteqia harishona lo haya lah hepseq vesop vehatteqia haacharona lo haya lah rosh vehatchala sheasa hakkol binshima achat. Veap al pi shehaiqqar kassebara harishona, mikkol maqom yesh lachosh lassebara haacharona veyachazor veyitqa kol hag' qolot:

Veim mashak veheerik batteqia haacharona shel baba achat (perush seder tshr"t achat o tsh"t achat o tr"t achat niqret baba achat) mibbabot tshr"t o tsh"t o tr"t kede shiur shette teqiot kede shettaaleh lo teqia zo lishte teqiot, dehaynu leshem teqia acharona shel baba zo uleshem teqia rishona shel baba shelleachareha — lo olta lo ella bishbil teqia achat, dehaynu teqia acharona shel baba zo, lepi shekkol teqia tzarik lihyot bo rosh vesop, veim nechalleq teqia zo lishte teqiot kemo shechashab hattoqea en kan rosh latteqia haacharona velo sop litqia rishona, ulepikak en anu holekin achar machashabto bazeh ella anu choshebin teqia zo litqia achat arukka, veola lo bishbil teqia acharona shel baba zo:

Veyesh choleqin veomerim shehakkol holek achar machashabto, vekevan shehu chashab shettaaleh lo lishte teqiot anu choshebin otah kishte teqiot ushettehen pesulot mittaam shennitbaer, ulekak enah ola lo apillu bishbil teqia achat, vetzarik lachazor velitqoa teqia rishona shel baba zo veyigmor mishsham vaelak al hasseder, kedin mi shettaa beemtza baba shechozer larosh kemo sheyyitbaer. Vahalaka kassebara harishona, umikkol maqom tob lachosh lassebara haacharona:

Ap al pi shellekattechilla asur lehasiach mittechillat teqiot meyushshab ad sop hatteqiot meummad kemo sheyyitbaer besiman taqatz"[b], mikkol maqom im abar hattoqea vesach, apillu hipsiq kamma shaot besicha apillu ben teqia litrua uben terua litqia uben baba lebaba uben seder leseder — en tzarik lachazor velitqoa. Apillu hipsiq ben haqqolot shebbebaba achat beqolot acherim, kegon shelleachar shettaqa o leachar sheheria nitasseq bitqiot o bitruot acherot vehipsiq bahem ben hatterua shel otah habbaba lehatteqiot shellepaneha uleachareha — en bekak kelum, dekevan shello nitkavven baqqolot haellu shennitasseq bahem beemtza habbaba leshem mitzva ella kemitasseq bealma, lepikak enan chashubin hepseq ben hatterua lappeshuta shellepaneha veshelleachareha, lepi shello hiqpida tora ella shello yapsiq benehem beqol shopar sheeno pashut shennitkavven bo hattoqea leshem mitzva, deaz en kan peshuta lepaneha o leachareha ella qol shopar sheeno pashut lepaneha o leachareha, abal im lo nitkavven bo hattoqea leshem mitzva en kan qol shopar sheeno pashut lepaneha o leachareha, lepi sheen qolo nechshab liklum vedomeh leqol behema vechayya kevan shello nitkavven bo leshem mitzva:

Veken hashshomea, im shama hatteqiot beserugin, dehaynu shehipsiq benetayim harbeh besicha — yatza, vehu shebbeemtza habbaba lo shama qol shopar sheeno rauy beoto maqom, dehaynu shebben hatterua shel habbaba lehappeshuta shellepaneha veshelleachareha lo shama qol shopar sheeno pashut leshem mitzva, veal derek shennitbaer betoqea:

Veken en tzarik sheyyishma kol hatteqiot meadam echad, ella apillu im shama otan mikkamma bene adam teqia mizzeh uterua mizzeh uteqia mizzeh veken ad sop kol haqqolot — yatza. Abal im shama teqia terua teqia mishshelosha bene adam shettaqeu kullam keechad zeh teqia vezeh terua vezeh teqia — lo yatza, lepi sheen kan peshuta lepaneha upeshuta leachareha kevan shekkullam taqeu bebat achat. Veim kol echad veechad mishsheloshtan taqeu teqia terua teqia, ap al pi shekkol haqqolot yotzein bebat achat ub' qolot hayyotzein bebat achat en shomein apillu achat mehen kemo shennitbaer besiman qm"a, mikkol maqom beshopar kevan dechabib hu al hashshomea, lepi sheeno ella paam beshana, hu noten dato veshomea apillu kamma qolot. Ulepikak apillu miqtzatam taqeu bachatzotzerot umiqtzatan taqeu beshopar — yatzeu, demechamat chabibuto natan dato al hashshopar lishmoa qolo:

Toqea haomed beseder tshr"t uleachar shettaqa shene shebarim qodem shessiyyem sheber hashshelishi taa vehitchil leharia, ben sheggamar et hatterua shehitchil bah betaut ben shello gemarah adayin ella nizkar baemtza — yachazor veyitqa g' shebarim veyaria veyigmor mishsham vaelak al hasseder. Abal eno tzarik lachazor velitqoa et hatteqia harishona shel baba zo, shekkebar taqa qodem shettaa. Veap al pi shehipsiq bishne shebarim uterua shettaqa betaut ben teqia rishona shel baba zo lishbarim uterua shel baba zo — en bekak kelum, dekevan shehashshebarim terua shettaqa betaut hen meen shebarim terua sheyyesh lo litqoa bebaba zo — en zeh hepseq, ha lemah zeh domeh letoqea shemmatchil leharia veen haqqol oleh yapeh uposeq vechozer umatchil leharia, sheen haqqol haqqatzar sheyyishmeu bashshopar chashub hepseq ben terua lappeshuta shellepaneha, kevan shehu meen terua shetztzarik litqoa:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Beseder tshr"t, abal im omed beseder tsh"t, ben shehitchil leharia leachar sheggamar hashshebarim, ben shehitchil leharia qodem sheggamar hashshebarim apillu lo asa ella sheber echad, ben shehitchil leharia qodem shettaqa apillu sheber echad — tzarik lachazor velitqoa gam teqia harishona shel baba zo, dekevan ditrua zo enah meen hashshebarim shetztzarik lo litqoa bebaba zo, lepikak hi chashuba hepseq ben hashshebarim lappeshuta shellepaneha. Vaapillu beseder tshr"t lo ameru sheen tzarik lachazor velitqoa teqia rishona, ella keshello hipsiq binshima ben siyyum hashshene shebarim lehatchalat hatterua sheheria betaut, abal im hipsiq benehem binshima — tzarik lachazor velitqoa gam teqia harishona shel baba zo, dekevan shehipsiq binshima ben hashshebarim lehatterua — en shenehem nechshabim kitqia ha', veen hatterua mitztarepet kelal im hashshebarim, vahare zeh domeh lemi sheheria terua lebaddo belo shebarim qodem shettaqa hashshelosha shebarim beseder tshr"t, detzarik lachazor velitqoa teqia rishona shel baba zo, lepi shehipsiq bitrua zo ben hashshebarim lappeshuta shellipnehem, shehare terua zo enah meen hashshebarim shetztzerikim lo litqoa bebaba zo, veap al pi shehu meen hatterua shetztzarik lo litqoa bebaba zo — en zo moil kelum, kevan shello taqa adayin hashshebarim shel baba zo:

Veken im leachar shettaqa shelosha shebarim ben beseder tshr"t ben beseder tsh"t hipsiq binshima vechazar vetaqa shebarim acherim, vaapillu lo chazar vetaqa ella sheber echad, veken im leachar sheggamar et hatterua dehaynu shelosha terumitin lepi sebara harishona shebbearnu hipsiq binshima vechazar veheria, apillu lo gamar et hatterua — tzarik lachazor velitqoa gam teqia rishona shel baba zo vegomer mishsham vaelak al hasseder, dekevan shehipsiq bishbarim yeterim o bitrua yetera ben hashshebarim o ben hatterua lappeshuta shelleacharehen, veim yachazor veyitqa hashshebarim o hatterua veyigmor mishsham vaelak al hasseder — yihyu hashshebarim hayterim o hatterua haytera shettaqa kebar hepseq ben hashshebarim o hatterua hakkesherim shel baba zo lappeshuta shellipnehen, lepi sheenan meen shebarim o terua shetztzarik lo litqoa bebaba zo, shehare en tzarik lo kelum kevan shekkebar taqa otam:

Kol maqom shennitbaer shetztzarik lachazor velitqoa gam teqia rishona shel habbaba, im lo nizkar mehattaut ad leachar shettaqa teqia acharona shel habbaba — otah teqia acharona ola lo bimqom teqia rishona vegomer mishsham vaelak al hasseder. Veim lo nizkar ad sheomed bebaba acheret, o apillu beseder acher, kegon shettaa misseder tshr"t velo nizkar ad sheomed beseder tsh"t o tr"t — gomer kol hasseder shennizkar bo veachar kak toqea baba achat tshr"t. Veap al pi shehipsiq beemtza hasseder shel tshr"t bitqiot shel tsh"t — en bekak kelum, shello hiqpida tora ella shello lehapsiq ben terua lipshuta shellepaneha veshelleachareha, abal im mapsiq ben baba lebaba apillu beqol shopar sheeno rauy leoto seder — en bekak kelum:

Kol maqom shennitbaer sheim taa tzarik lachazor velitqoa teqia rishona shel baba zo shettaa bah — en chilluq ben teqiot meummad litqiot meyushshab, bekol achat mehen tzarik lachazor veal derek shennitbaer. Vaapillu bemaqom shettoqein kol hashsheloshim qolot bitqiot meummad — en omerim sheim taa hattoqea bitqiot meyushshab nismok al teqiot meummad velo yehe tzarik lachazor, dekevan shebberak al teqiot ellu tzarik laasotan kahogen shello tehe birkato lebattala. Abal im taa batteqiot sheachar hattepilla — en bekak kelum, lepi sheenan raq minhag bealma:
Im taqa batztzad harachab shel shopar — lo yatza, veremez laddabar "min hammetzar qarati vego'":

Veachar shettaqa yatchil hashsheliach tzibbur "ashre haam yodee terua vego'", veyesh nohagin lomar ad "tarum qarnenu", veachar kak yatchil "ashre yoshebe veku'", veachar kak machazirin hasseper tora limqomo:
